contribution.name: Technocore DID identity-note sharding compatibility
contribution.motivation: The official identity-note convention moved new writes from one legacy did namespace to a two-character namespace shard, while the client still generated only the legacy path.
contribution.summary: Publish new DID notes at /kv/did-<first 2 fingerprint characters>/<remaining 14>, document the legacy read fallback, and lock the convention with a fixed-vector regression test.

validation.compile_check: agent.py and test_agent.py compiled successfully with an isolated pycache
validation.dry_run: The existing public DID produced the expected did-<shard>/<key> registry path without a network write.
validation.secret_scan: The identity private value, common credential patterns, private filenames, local absolute paths, and real email patterns were absent from the committed Git history.

technocore.verification: The signed write returned HTTP 200. A JSON read of sequence 3 returned the expected full did:key author, exact nonce, timestamp, commit URL, and message text.
